hero.title: Build with an agent factory
hero.lead: Turn a repository into a working factory. Agents pick up scoped work, collaborate, and ship changes you can review.

welcome.title: Welcome back
welcome.description: Sign in to continue building with your team.

failure.askAdmin: Ask an organization admin to add your account, then sign in again.
failure.statusUnavailable: Unable to check your sign-in status. Check your connection and try again.

errors.authUnavailable: Factory could not check your access right now.

sessionExpired.title: Session expired
sessionExpired.description: You’re no longer signed in. Factory has stopped receiving updates. Sign in again to continue where you left off.

guards.notConfiguredTitle: This Factory server has no authentication provider configured
guards.notConfiguredBody: Factory web requires authenticated remote Factories. Configure a supported auth provider on the server, then reload this page.
guards.unavailableBody: Factory could not check your access: this is a server problem, not your sign-in. Try again in a moment.

invite.title: Invitation to {{organization}}
invite.description: {{inviter}} invited you to join {{organization}} with the {{role}} role.
invite.wrongEmail: This invitation is for a different email. You are signed in as {{email}}: sign out and sign in with Google using the invited email.
invite.notFound: This invitation has expired, was cancelled, or was already used. Ask for a new link.

consent.title: Allow access to Factory
consent.description: {{client}} asks to use Factory as you: read and change work items and sessions in your organization, the same as you can in the web app.

scopes.offline_access: Staying connected until you sign out (refresh tokens)

consent.invalid: This page needs the request an MCP client starts. Connect from the client again.
consent.signInFirst: An MCP client asks to connect to Factory. Sign in first, then allow it.

join.title: Join {{organization}}
join.alreadyMember: You are already a member of {{organization}}.

refusal.expired: This join link has expired. Ask an admin for a new one.
refusal.revoked: This join link was revoked. Ask an admin for a new one.
refusal.used_up: This join link has been used as many times as it allows. Ask an admin for a new one.
refusal.domain_not_allowed: This join link does not admit {{email}}. Sign out and sign in with Google using an email the link allows.
refusal.email_not_verified: Your email is not verified, so the link cannot admit it.

join.notFound: This join link does not exist. Check that you copied all of it.
join.failed: Could not open the join link: {{message}}
